checks: The proxy implementation slot, owner, version, linked Identity Registry, and three runtime bytecode hashes were read from Linea Sepolia.
ERC-8004 agent 2 was owned by and registered to the MetaMask Agent Wallet at proof time.

The validation subject was re-checked: the pinned Agent Wallet transaction succeeded through the Delegation Manager, emitted the expected Reputation Registry feedback, and the agreement remains DONE with unrevoked feedback.
The Agent Wallet mined ValidationRequest successfully and its exact indexed and non-indexed event fields match the fixture.
A distinct one-run testnet EOA mined ValidationResponse successfully and its exact event fields match the fixture.
getValidationStatus, getSummary, getAgentValidations, and getValidatorRequests all include the expected final state.
Five negative controls were mined with status 0 and rebound to their exact Error(string) reasons through block-pinned eth_call.
A second public RPC (linea-sepolia-rpc.publicnode.com) independently returned the same request/response block hashes and final validation state.
The runner made no Agent Wallet policy mutation and proved the policy remained byte-for-byte unchanged before emitting evidence.

proofCeiling: This evidence proves one pinned official-repository-configured Linea Sepolia Validation Registry path: the Agent Wallet-owned agent 2 requested validation; a distinct one-run CNS-controlled testnet EOA responded; and the exact tested authorization, duplicate, zero-address, wrong-validator, and response-range controls reverted on-chain. It does not prove third-party validator independence, official maintainer endorsement beyond the address and source pins, economics, challenge/slashing/finality or penalty routing, audit or security status, production or mainnet readiness, demand, or token necessity.
